meta.principle: Near-monochrome ink-and-paper editorial system. Color is reserved for price direction (green/red), one caution amber for data-freshness, and structural black. No rounded corners except circular avatars/pills/toggles.
meta.note: REFERENCE ONLY — checked in as the in-repo source of truth for the hand-maintained @theme block in src/app/globals.css. Not consumed at build time (no generator per P0 brief); diff globals.css against this file to detect drift.

ink.usage: Primary text, primary buttons/fills, rules, headlines

ink.soft.usage: Dark-surface secondary fills, hover backgrounds on dark

ink.mid.usage: Body copy on light surfaces, button hover fill

ink.hairline.strong.usage: Input borders, chip borders, disabled fills

paper.tint.usage: Page background, tinted panels/callouts, hover row fill

paper.board.usage: Board/backdrop behind the 1440px canvas and email bodies — not a content-surface color

positive.usage: Price up, gains, buy ratings, positive deltas (light surfaces)

negative.usage: Price down, losses, sell/halt, negative deltas (light surfaces)

positive.dark.usage: Positive values on dark data-room surfaces

negative.dark.usage: Negative values on dark data-room surfaces

caution.usage: Freshness/degraded states only — reconnecting, delayed, auction, stale, halted-adjacent. Never used for price.

caution.text.usage: Caution text on light backgrounds (AA contrast)

heatmap.scale.usage: Sequential −3%…+3% intensity scale, dark data-room only

family.display.usage: Headlines, hero numerals (Score), editorial pull-quotes. Weights 400–800, optical sizing on.

family.ui.usage: Body copy, UI labels, buttons, form fields. Weights 300–800.

family.mono.usage: Tickers, prices, timestamps, eyebrow labels, data tables. Weights 400–600.

body.sm.usage: Table cells, dense copy, card body

section.title.usage: Page H1 for calendars/hubs (e.g. 'Earnings calendar', 'Dividend calendar') — the low end of the heading range, given its own named step because SectionBar/StatStrip callers key off it directly

article.title.usage: Lead story / article page H1 — the low end of the display range, named for the same reason as section.title

spacing.note: Recommended 4px-base scale for new engineering work. Existing screens use organic intermediate values (e.g. 6, 7, 9, 14, 18, 22, 26, 30, 34) as micro-adjustments — treat those as acceptable one-off refinements, not new scale steps.

radius.circular: 50% — avatars, toggle knobs, bullet dots, radio buttons
radius.note: Deliberately sharp-cornered system (newspaper aesthetic). Do not introduce card/button border-radius.

motion.hover.transition: background/border/transform, ~120–160ms ease (implicit — not currently time-coded in specimens)
motion.flash.tick: brief highlight (~600ms suggested) on live value update — not yet time-coded
